Community Rules

🔞 18+ only
Every member is verified by a real human before they can post.
✅ Consensual adult content welcome
Explicit photos and videos are allowed — if everyone in it agreed to share it.
🚫 Zero tolerance for minors
Anything involving anyone under 18. Ever. No warnings, no second chances.
🧔 Fellas: some facial hair in your verification selfie
Male selfies need some kind of facial hair — clean-shaven doesn't get approved. It's the house look.
⚠️ Report it
See something wrong? Tap ⋯ on any post and report it. Reports go straight to Lucky — violating posts get removed, and big violations lose the account.

Dating Rules

💋 Flirty, romantic, respectful
BindR is flirty dating — playful energy, real chemistry, good manners.
🚫 No nudity or porn
Keep it outside the bedroom. Every photo/video is auto-screened before it goes live — explicit content is blocked on the spot. Screening isn't perfect: swimwear or art can be flagged by mistake (appeal and a human reviews it), and clever crops can slip through (report them).
🚫 No harassment, no hate
Unwanted advances, threats, slurs — none of it lives here.
⚠️ Break it, lose it
Violating posts come down. Repeat offenders lose their account.
